description: Two `version: 1` calls (one bare, one with `count: 2`): a v1 UUID depends on the time and the host (the MAC-address/clock-sequence node in the standard, `uuid.uuid1`'s own randomness fallback when no real MAC is available), so neither its exact value nor its relationship across two calls can ever be pinned byte-for-byte, even between two runs of the same engine -- `third_party_text` checks the shape only (a standard dashed UUID with the version nibble `1`), at every location the values land. The monotonic-ordering guarantee stays a Rust unit test (`electricity-tools/src/uuid.rs`); v5 is covered by `uuid-v5-and-errors`.
